title: OpenCodeLaw 1.0
description: Machine-readable organizational constitution with permanent citation identifiers. Root key is `opencodelaw`, resolving the historical three-way disagreement between the docs (`OpenCodeLaw`), the specs (`openconstitution`) and the renderer (`ammendments`). The amendment register is a separate document; see $defs/actRegister.

opencodelaw.description: Schema version. Quoted so YAML does not coerce it to a float.

articles.description: Order is presentational only. Identity comes from `id`/`number`, never from array position, so reordering this list changes no citation and no anchor.

actId.description: Stable Act identifier: act-<number>-<year>, e.g. act-1-2024.

nonEmptyText.description: Provision text. Must contain at least one non-whitespace character. An empty string is rejected: Article 11 published a blank body for two years because nothing checked this.

provenance.description: Records text that entered the constitution outside the amendment process. Its purpose is to preserve a half-amended state rather than erase it: an edit with no enacting instrument must be visible, not silently normalised.

applied_outside_process.description: True when this text was hand-applied with no recorded amendment.

matches_act.description: Act whose prescribed text this current text matches, where one was identified.

organization.description: Full legal name of the body the constitution governs.

registration.description: Registration identifier under the governing statute.

status.description: Exactly one document in the corpus may be `current`.

superseded_by.description: Version that replaced this one. Required in practice for archived pages, which must name their successor in a visible banner.

provisionStatus.description: `active` (default when absent) carries text. `reserved` holds a number that no provision occupies — this is how a statute book represents a gap without renumbering. `omitted` marks a provision repealed by an Act; its number is never reused.

id.description: Permanent citation identifier and public URL anchor. Treat as a public API: never regenerate, never derive from array position.

number.description: The number the Acts cite. Explicit, never derived from index. Article 21 is `number: 21` even when it is the 20th element of the list.

note.description: Required for `reserved`/`omitted`: why this number carries no text.

allOf.$comment: A reserved or omitted article carries a note instead of text. Everything else must carry non-empty content.

id.description: Permanent citation identifier, e.g. art-6-s-1. Must agree with the parent article's number and this section's number; validate.mjs enforces the relationship.

actRegister.$comment: Root schema for acts/register.yaml. Validated separately by validate.mjs, versioned in this file so the register and the constitution cannot drift apart.

assent_date.description: Date of assent, as stated on the face of the instrument.

passed_date.description: Date of passage, a distinct event from assent. One field cannot hold both.

signed_by.description: Who signed the instrument, as printed on it.

moved_by.description: Who moved the Act. Leave unset rather than guessing.

unverified_attribution.description: An attribution recorded elsewhere but unsupported by the face of the instrument. Preserved rather than deleted or promoted, pending confirmation.

drafting_discrepancy.description: Where an Act contradicts itself. Recorded, never silently normalised: a reader must be able to see that the instrument disagrees with itself and which text governs.

statement_of_objects.description: The conflicting explanatory text, which does not govern.

procedure.description: The approval chain the constitution required when the Act was passed. Left explicit and unpopulated where the evidence has not been located: an empty chain of authority is visible, a missing field is not.

required_by.description: Provision id of the amendment procedure in force at the time.

evidence.description: Link or reference to the minutes recording this approval.

pdf.description: Repository-relative path. validate.mjs fails the build if the file is absent from disk.

source_text.description: Repository-relative path to the extracted plain text, so every assertion below is diffable against a source in the repo.

amends.description: Provision ids this Act touches. Every entry must resolve against the constitution.

target.description: Provision id, e.g. art-6-s-1 or `preamble`. Must resolve.

scope.description: Read from the instrument, not from its heading: an Act that restates the article's own heading followed by a complete clause run substitutes the whole article; an Act whose heading names clauses, and sets out only those, amends only them.

clauses.description: Which clauses the Act names, e.g. "1,2,3,4,5". Required for clause scope, so a targeted amendment can never be recorded without saying what it targets.

source_lines.description: Line range in source_text supporting this assertion, e.g. "18-33".
